description: If a propositional theory \(\Gamma\) is finitely satisfiable, its allowed assignments on every finite atom set \(F\) form a nonempty set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.allowed_rows_nonempty.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hfin : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.FiniteSatisfiable Γ) (F : Finset α) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.AllowedRows Γ F).Nonempty
